films.title: Marvel Super Hero Adventures: Frost Fight!
films.version: 2015 animated special directed by Mitch Schauer, Disney+ edition
films.on_screen: Thor and Hulk take a screaming Santa look-alike aboard their sleigh.

draft_proposal.verdict_rationale: Rocket talks about what the trip could buy him. His passenger describes someone who spends the whole year preparing gifts for children. The holiday adventure gives both service and careless treatment of others room on screen.
draft_proposal.age_rationale: Slapstick kicks and fantasy weapons accompany the search. A frightened man is carried away in a sleigh by people he cannot stop. That loss of control may bother a young child even though the action has little injury detail.

films.title: Marvel Rising: Secret Warriors
films.version: 2018 animated television feature premiered September 30 on Disney Channel and Disney XD
films.on_screen: Hala threatens the captives’ families to force Kamala and Dante to fight. The captives instead cooperate.

draft_proposal.verdict_rationale: Hala threatens two families to make her prisoners fight. Kamala and Dante refuse to treat one another as enemies and get the other prisoners out. The film lets Kamala revise her judgment of the boy she first saw stealing, while showing how Victor exploits a young person’s desire to belong.
draft_proposal.age_rationale: Repeated fights include fire and energy weapons. The more difficult sequence for some children may be Hala threatening the captives’ families so the teenagers will hurt each other.

theme_ratings.rating_rationale: Helping the other captives decides the outcome of the confrontation.
